description: Return the top ten plus every row tied with the tenth.

d.request: For each transref in sentimentandfundamentals, compute the mean anlycount (excluding nulls); filter transrefs whose mean exceeds the overall mean; rank filtered transrefs by their deviation from the filtered mean in descending order; return the top 10 rows plus any additional rows tied with the 10th highest deviation, with missing values ranked last.
d.sql:
WITH overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(anlycount) as overall_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
),
transref_means AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as mean_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT tm.transref, tm.mean_anlycount
  FROM transref_means tm
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE tm.mean_anlycount > om.overall_avg
),
filtered_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(mean_anlycount) as filtered_avg
  FROM above_overall
  WHERE mean_anlycount IS NOT NULL
),
with_deviation AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.transref,
    ao.mean_anlycount,
    CASE 
      WHEN ao.mean_anlycount IS NULL THEN NULL 
      ELSE ABS(ao.mean_anlycount - fm.filtered_avg) 
    END as deviation
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN filtered_mean fm
),
ranked_results AS (
  SELECT 
    transref,
    mean_anlycount,
    deviation,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN deviation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 
               deviation DESC
    ) as rn,
    NTH_VALUE(deviation, 10) OVER (
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN deviation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 
               deviation DESC
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) as tenth_deviation
  FROM with_deviation
)
SELECT 
  transref,
  mean_anlycount,
  deviation
FROM ranked_results
WHERE rn <= 10 
   OR (deviation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM tenth_deviation)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN deviation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 
         deviation DESC

a.request: For each transaction in `sentimentandfundamentals` (`transref`), take the average analyst coverage count (`anlycount`, ignoring missing values). Keep only the transactions whose average is above the overall average of those per-transaction averages. For each one, show `transref`, its average, how far it is above that overall average, and how far it is above the average among just the kept transactions. Sort by that last difference, highest first (missing last), and return the top 10 rows plus every other row tied with the 10th. Don't round.
a.sql:
WITH per_transaction_avg AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    AVG(anlycount) as avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as overall_average
  FROM per_transaction_avg
),
kept_transactions AS (
  SELECT
    pta.transref,
    pta.avg_anlycount,
    oa.overall_average,
    pta.avg_anlycount - oa.overall_average as diff_from_overall
  FROM per_transaction_avg pta
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE pta.avg_anlycount > oa.overall_average
),
kept_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as kept_average
  FROM kept_transactions
),
with_all_cols AS (
  SELECT
    kt.transref,
    kt.avg_anlycount,
    kt.diff_from_overall,
    kt.avg_anlycount - kav.kept_average as diff_from_kept
  FROM kept_transactions kt
  CROSS JOIN kept_avg_val kav
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    avg_anlycount,
    diff_from_overall,
    diff_from_kept,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY diff_from_kept DESC NULLS LAST) as rn
  FROM with_all_cols
),
tenth AS (
  SELECT diff_from_kept FROM ordered WHERE rn = 10
)
SELECT
  transref,
  avg_anlycount,
  diff_from_overall,
  diff_from_kept
FROM ordered
WHERE rn <= 10
  OR (CASE WHEN (SELECT diff_from_kept FROM tenth) IS NOT NULL
        THEN diff_from_kept = (SELECT diff_from_kept FROM tenth)
        ELSE diff_from_kept IS NULL END)
ORDER BY
  diff_from_kept DESC NULLS LAST

b.request: For each transref, calculate the mean anlycount; filter to transrefs above the overall mean of those transref means; for each filtered transref, output transref, its mean, its deviation from the overall mean, and its deviation from the filtered-transref mean; sort descending by the last deviation and return the top 10 rows plus every row tied with the 10th row's deviation value.
b.sql: WITH transref_means AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as mean_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(mean_anlycount) as overall_mean FROM transref_means), filtered_transrefs AS (SELECT tm.transref, tm.mean_anlycount FROM transref_means tm CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE tm.mean_anlycount > om.overall_mean), filtered_overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(mean_anlycount) as filtered_mean FROM filtered_transrefs), with_deviations AS (SELECT ft.transref, ft.mean_anlycount, ft.mean_anlycount - om.overall_mean as deviation_from_overall, ft.mean_anlycount - fom.filtered_mean as deviation_from_filtered, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ft.mean_anlycount - fom.filtered_mean DESC) as rn FROM filtered_transrefs ft CROSS JOIN overall_mean om CROSS JOIN filtered_overall_mean fom) SELECT transref, mean_anlycount, deviation_from_overall, deviation_from_filtered FROM with_deviations WHERE rn <= 10 OR deviation_from_filtered = (SELECT deviation_from_filtered FROM with_deviations WHERE rn = 10) ORDER BY deviation_from_filtered DESC

c.request: For each transaction in `sentimentandfundamentals` (`transref`), take the average analyst coverage count (`anlycount`, ignoring missing values). Keep only the transactions whose average is above the overall average of those per-transaction averages. For each one, show `transref`, its average, how far it is above that overall average, and how far it is above the average among just the kept transactions. Give me the top 10 by that last difference, highest first (missing last). Don't round. Return the top ten plus every row tied with the tenth.
c.sql: WITH trans_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as trans_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as overall_average FROM trans_averages), kept_transactions AS (SELECT ta.transref, ta.trans_avg, oa.overall_average FROM trans_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ta.trans_avg > oa.overall_average), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as kept_average FROM kept_transactions), results AS (SELECT kt.transref, kt.trans_avg, kt.trans_avg - kt.overall_average as above_overall, kt.trans_avg - ka.kept_average as above_kept FROM kept_transactions kt CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST) as rn FROM results) SELECT transref, trans_avg, above_overall, above_kept FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 OR above_kept = (SELECT above_kept FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10 LIMIT 1) ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST
